question: Should this contributor PR become the security-boundary fix after the Worker Google aliases, release-note ownership, and real-proof gaps are addressed?
rationale: The patch touches documented credential-redaction guarantees, and merging it incomplete could close open security reports while leaving a Worker diagnostic leak path behind.

options.title: Require Fix And Proof
options.body: Have the contributor add the missing Worker Google aliases/tests, remove the release-owned CHANGELOG edit, and post redacted live-output or log proof before maintainer security review.

options.title: Accept Narrower Scope
options.body: A maintainer may intentionally land the punctuation fix while keeping Google signed-URL Worker redaction tracked in a separate explicit issue or PR.

options.title: Prepare Maintainer-Owned Patch
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer to handle the security-boundary fix privately or in a consolidated maintainer-authored change.

recommendation.title: Require Fix And Proof
recommendation.body: Have the contributor add the missing Worker Google aliases/tests, remove the release-owned CHANGELOG edit, and post redacted live-output or log proof before maintainer security review.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main history across the diagnostic redaction implementation and security docs.
